description:
6-8 years of hands on development experience in Java EE and open source framework such as Spring, Hibernate 
Strong knowledge of Service Oriented Architecture / Web Services - SOAP / REST. 
Experience in build tools especially in Gradle / Maven and Continuous Integration tools like Jenkins 
Strong development experience on Spring-boot is MUST 
Experience in Spring Batch/ Spring Securities/ Spring DAO-ORM modules 
REST Web Services Development experience (Implementation and Consumption) is MUST 
Experience on Cloud related technologies 
Excellent analytical and problem solving skills and should be able to provide input to improve business process. 
Effective interpersonal and communication skills 
Ability to work with no or limited guidance, grasp the concepts quickly and develop in an agile mode.



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
